name: Stoke Space
summary: Stoke Space is developing a fully reusable launch vehicle. Its September 2026 Series E was reported at a $9 billion private-market valuation, while the company announced a $1 billion financing.
overview: Stoke Space is building a fully reusable launch system aimed at lowering the cost and increasing the cadence of access to orbit. The company is progressing from technology demonstration toward commercial launch capability.

bear_case: Orbital launch is technically unforgiving and capital-intensive; the reported $9B valuation depends on execution far beyond financing.

company: Stoke Space is developing a fully reusable launch vehicle intended to increase launch cadence and reduce the cost of access to orbit. The core proof point is reliable flight and recovery performance, not only fundraising.

The company announced a $1 billion Series E in September 2026. Private-market data providers reported a $9 billion valuation; that figure is labelled as reported rather than company-disclosed pricing.
intelligence.why_it_matters: Stoke is among the high-value private launch bets competing for a market shaped by reusability. Flight tests, payload contracts and launch reliability will determine whether the valuation holds.

takeaways: The $1B Series E is company-announced; the $9B valuation is reported context.
Stoke's thesis is full reusability in orbital launch.
Flight and recovery performance are the key underwriting milestones.
